title: Tesla plans Cybercab sales to transport companies
excerpt: Tesla aims to begin selling its Cybercabs to other transport businesses before the end of the year.
body_html:
Tesla is reportedly aiming to begin selling its Cybercabs to various transport companies prior to the conclusion of the year.

The electric vehicle maker has outlined plans to offer these autonomous vehicles to commercial transport operators. Further details regarding production milestones, pricing, or specific launch dates were not provided in the announcement.
